prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
**American Construction, Inc.** looks like a solid starting point for a larger remodel: it says it has served Joplin since 1993, handles remodeling and related work, and is licensed, bonded, and insured. It offers a one-year labor warranty. Call **417-781-6811** for an estimate. [Company website](https://www.americanconstructionincorporated.com/)

For smaller repairs or handyman work, **Shere’s Construction & Handyman** is another option. Its BBB profile lists an **A+ rating and accreditation**, and describes remodeling and general repair services. Call **417-385-8899**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/sheres-construction-handyman-0734-1000009996)

These are leads, not guarantees. Before hiring, get at least three written bids, confirm current insurance and any required local permits, and ask for recent references and a clear payment schedule.
